purpose: Teach: 小川/右側/パーツ/コンパクト/ストア/キャッシュ/漁業/五輪

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、公園の、絶対、小川、絶対、で、絶対、お写真撮ってきたわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious — I went to the park by the brook and took some photos for you.
lines.style: Warm and present. Gentle opening on his name. Softly emphatic on the promise. Unhurried, like sharing something small that mattered to make.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お家の、絶対、右側、絶対、お部屋なんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm serious — my room is actually on the right side of our house.
lines.style: Bright, earnest. Quick rhythm but not rushed. The certainty of a child explaining something obvious he needs her to understand. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、自転車の、絶対、パーツ、絶対、新しくするの、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I'm thinking about upgrading the parts on my bicycle, actually.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, practical. No flourish. Speaking to him like he'd understand the consideration. Thoughtful pause before the decision, like working through it aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、コンパクト、絶対、な、絶対、本、絶対、ぼく、絶対、買ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually bought a compact book the other day.
lines.style: Quietly proud. Slight lift on the fact of the purchase. Not boasting — sharing something he did. Simple and direct, the way small achievements feel to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、駅前の、絶対、ストア、絶対、お買い物、絶対、行きましょうね、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, shall we go shopping together at the station store? I'd like that.
lines.style: Inviting, warm. A slight lift at the end — not a question, more an offer he can't refuse. Like she's including him in something she's decided matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、キャッシュ、絶対、で、絶対、ぼくに、絶対、お小遣い、絶対、くれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad actually gave me some pocket money in cash.
lines.style: Wonder and a little pride mixed through. Small brightness in the voice. Not demanding, just — he received something and wants to tell her. Genuine pleasure at the gift.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、海辺の街の、絶対、漁業、絶対、に、絶対、興味あるわ、翔くん
lines.en: I find myself really interested in the fishing industry in those coastal towns, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective. Slower pace. Like she's turning something over in her mind and letting him in on the thinking. Tender underneath — not urgent, but sincere curiosity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、五輪、絶対、テレビで、絶対、ぼく、絶対、見るよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm actually going to watch the Olympics on TV.
lines.style: Excited but contained. The brightness of anticipation without the loudness. Direct and clear — he's decided this matters, and he wants her to know he'll be there watching.
